+# Spec
+
+## Problem
+The greet function hardcodes the trailing punctuation.
+
+## Business Rules
+Default output is unchanged when no suffix is given.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- AC1: Given name Ada and no suffix, when greet runs, then it returns "Hello, Ada!".
+- AC2: Given suffix "?", when greet runs, then it returns "Hello, Ada?".
+
+## Edge Cases
+Empty suffix returns "Hello, Ada" with no trailing punctuation.
+
+## Definition of Done
+Tests for AC1 and AC2 pass and default behaviour is preserved.
+
+## Must-not-change
+The single-argument call path keeps returning the exclamation mark.
*** End Patch
